note: Art queries for Homer's Iliad. Wikimedia Commons, PD/CC0 only. Unlike a modern novel, the Iliad is depicted directly across two and a half millennia of public-domain art: John Flaxman's 1795 line engravings (which illustrate the poem scene by scene), Neoclassical history painting (Ingres, Jacques-Louis David, Gavin Hamilton, Benjamin West, Tiepolo, Rubens), and ancient Greek vase painting. The fetcher adds 'filetype:bitmap', caps each download to ~3000px, and retries throttled requests.
